articles.title: Xi Jinping remits certificates of order to promote two military officers to general rank
articles.summary: Xi Jinping, president of China's Central Military Commission, presided over a ceremony to promote two military officers to the rank of general.

articles.title: Xi Jinping delivers speech at commemorative meeting for 105th anniversary of CCP founding
articles.summary: Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Communist Party of China, delivered a speech at the commemorative meeting for the Party's 105th anniversary.

articles.title: Xi Jinping: China ready to establish security partnership with Cambodia
articles.summary: Xi Jinping stated that China is willing to collaborate with Cambodia to preserve peace, advance development, and strengthen security cooperation.

articles.title: Xi Jinping calls for solid measures to modernize agriculture and rural areas
articles.summary: Xi Jinping called for comprehensive measures to advance the modernization of agriculture and rural areas during an inspection tour in Shandong province.
